description: This Java class represents an MMS 'Read Receipt Indication' PDU (Protocol Data Unit), providing methods to construct, parse, and manipulate the headers and data fields related to read receipt indication messages within the MMS protocol.

classes.name: ReadRecInd
classes.description: Represents a 'Read Receipt Indication' MMS PDU, providing constructors and accessors for message headers and fields related to read status messages.

methods.name: ReadRecInd(EncodedStringValue, byte[], int, int, EncodedStringValue[])
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new read receipt indication with specified header values.

methods.name: ReadRecInd(PduHeaders)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with provided headers.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date associated with the read receipt.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date associated with the read receipt.

methods.name: getMessageId
methods.description: Retrieves the Message-ID of the read receipt.

methods.name: setMessageId
methods.description: Sets the Message-ID of the read receipt.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Retrieves the list of recipients the read receipt is addressed to.

methods.name: setTo
methods.description: Sets the recipients for the read receipt.

methods.name: setReadStatus
methods.description: Sets the read status indicator, throws exception if invalid.
